assistants.desc_support: In-app help chat on Support for learners and company users: help-centre articles plus their own records, with a ticket when it can't help. Spends AI — off by default.
assistants.desc_org_onboarding: A setup checklist for new company and college admins, with copilot drafts for each step. Optional nudge e-mails.
assistants.desc_placement: A copilot specialist for college placement teams: readiness, students to nudge, drive shortlists, company practice. Optional weekly report e-mail.
assistants.desc_mentor_match: Mentor suggestions on the study plan from weak areas, target company, language and time zone. Optional follow-up after each session.
assistants.desc_revenue: A daily scan of plans, licences, seats and usage. Renewal reminders, upgrade notes and win-back coupons arrive in your copilot as proposals; nothing is sent until you confirm.
automations.nudges.title: Nudge limits
automations.nudges.intro: Every reminder from the nudge automations shares one frequency cap per person, so nobody gets several in a day. Unsubscribes, the email switch, quiet hours and WhatsApp consent always apply. Pre-charge renewal notices and staff digests are not capped.
automations.nudges.capDaily: Most nudges per person per day
automations.nudges.capDailyHelp: Deadline reminders (last-chance test, drive in an hour, offer expiring) get one extra slot.
automations.nudges.capWeekly: Most nudges per person per 7 days
automations.nudges.capWeeklyHelp: Applies to every nudge, deadlines included.
automations.nudges.couponPctHelp: One-time code sent 24 hours after an unpaid plan checkout. 0 = no coupon (default), at most 30.
automations.nudges.offerDaysHelp: Used when the application has no deadline of its own.
automations.nudges.bgvDaysHelp: A vendor check open longer than this is chased.
automations.nudges.aiMonthly: Content refresh AI budget per month (USD)
automations.nudges.aiMonthlyHelp: When reached, notes fall back to the template. The platform budget hard stop also applies.
automations.nudges.logEmptyHelp: Switch a nudge automation on and its sends, caps and stops show up here.
automations.nudges.freshEmptyHelp: The weekly check lists Learn posts and questions that are over a year old, mention deprecated APIs or have dead links.
automations.nudges.noteAi: Suggested refresh (AI draft — check before editing)

onboarding.copilot_first_test_company: Draft my first assessment: a 45-minute test for a junior backend developer with a few MCQs and two coding questions. Show me the proposal before saving.
onboarding.copilot_first_test_college: Draft a 60-minute aptitude and coding practice test for our final-year students. Show me the proposal before saving.
onboarding.copilot_first_invite_company: Help me invite candidates to my latest test. Ask me for the emails, then draft the invite proposal.
onboarding.copilot_first_invite_college: Help me invite students to our latest test. Ask me for the emails, then draft the invite proposal.
onboarding.copilot_first_job_company: Draft my first job opening for a software engineer (2–4 years). Ask me for anything you need, then show me the proposal.
onboarding.copilot_first_job_college: Draft a job opening for our placement cell. Ask me for the details first.
onboarding.copilot_first_drive_college: Show my placement drives and batch readiness, and tell me what to set up for the first drive.
